secondary_scenario.interpretation: Sensitivity only; no confirmed acquisition failure

overlap_definition: Intersection of observed retained min-max peak-voltage intervals, including endpoints. This is not a probability-distribution or confidence-interval overlap test.

methods.Source: D-.86.xlsx and L-.86.xlsx; 150000 rows, X=0..149999; 35 scans each; originals unchanged.
methods.Voltage: PROVISIONAL, UNVERIFIED: V_AC (mV)=X*0.002. No instrument calibration metadata found.
methods.Extraction: Global maximum of each unaligned raw curve. No smoothing, fitting, peak alignment or baseline subtraction.
methods.Normalization: I/Imax per scan. Exact normalization preserves maximum coordinates and FWHM.
methods.FWHM: Closest half-maximum crossings enclosing global maximum; linear interpolation of crossing positions only, not signal reconstruction.
methods.MAD: Unscaled median absolute deviation from full35 median. Modified Z=0.6745*(V-median)/MAD; abs(Z)>3.5.
methods.IQR: NumPy linear quantile interpolation. Strict outside Q1-1.5*IQR, Q3+1.5*IQR. Fixed full35 thresholds.
methods.Method A: Fixed descending absolute deviations from ORIGINAL full35 median; ties resolved by original scan number. No cutoff specified: ranking is not an outlier classification.
methods.Nesting: Same fixed order for k=0..10. Do not rerank or recompute anomaly thresholds after removal.
methods.Overlap: Intersection of observed retained min-max peak-voltage intervals, including endpoints. This is not a probability-distribution or confidence-interval overlap test.
methods.Recommendation: D0/L0: retain all70 as primary. D3/L0 and D2/L0 are sensitivity scenarios, not proven acquisition failures.
methods.Rationale: D has threshold candidates but no confirmed acquisition errors; no established stability plateau or instrument tolerance. L has no IQR/modified-Z candidates.
methods.Selection bias: Trimming centralizes retained data by design. Lower post-filter SD does not demonstrate improved instrument repeatability; Delta V is not an optimization objective.
methods.Scan index: Y1..Y35 are curve numbers. Their acquisition chronology and independence are unverified; no inferential p-values or temporal-drift claims are made.
methods.Renderer: Actual figures rendered using Matplotlib; Origin Windows runtime unavailable; no native OPJU generated.

recommendation_basis: No confirmed acquisition faults; D k3 slope change is not a stable plateau; L has no threshold candidates. Preserve full data as primary.
